Version-selection rationale (dependency due diligence — SPZ Task 1):
  - On upstream main (as of 2026-07, e.g. c538491), load-spz.cc unconditionally includes
    <zlib.h> and <zstd.h> — the NGSP (SPZ header v4+) format uses zstd multi-stream
    compression, and there is no build flag to conditionally exclude the zstd path
    (excluding it would require a source patch).
  - zstd introduction commit: 51008f8 ("Switch to zstd & ... parallel zstd streams", 2026-04-29).
    zstd is mandatory from v3.0.0 (5bf2945, 2026-05-04) onward. The iOS/macOS SDK provides
    only zlib (libz.tbd) and zstd is not a linkable system library, so we vendor v2.1.0,
    the last tagged release that does not use zstd (Global Constraints option (a)).
  - v2.1.0 reads SPZ header versions 1–3 (single gzip stream) and writes version 3.
    Compression uses zlib (deflate/gzip) only — link: -lz (Apple SDK libz.tbd, common to
    macOS/iOS).
  - The commit differs from the research/spz checkout (c538491, reference only) because of
    the zstd constraint above.

Vendored verbatim, without modification. On upgrade, update this file plus NOTICE and docs/provenance.md.
(If we ever decide to vendor a bundled zstd, this can be raised to latest main + NGSP v4 support.)
